items.name: middleware-hono
items.title: Hono Middleware
items.description: Hono middleware that attaches request-scoped amplio context.
items.docs: Wire the middleware: `app.use("*", amplioMiddleware())` in your Hono app. `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha doctor` verifies it is imported.

items.name: middleware-express
items.title: Express Middleware
items.description: Express middleware that attaches request-scoped amplio context.
items.docs: Wire the middleware: `app.use(amplioMiddleware())` before your routes. `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha doctor` verifies it is imported.

items.name: middleware-next
items.title: Next.js Route Handler Wrapper
items.description: Route-handler wrapper (withAmplio) that owns the request wide event - this is not Next.js middleware.ts.
items.docs: Wrap route handlers: `export const GET = withAmplio(handler)`. In a create-t3-app layout, `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha init --wire` edits src/app/api/trpc/[trpc]/route.ts for you.

items.name: middleware-fastify
items.title: Fastify Middleware
items.description: Fastify plugin that attaches request-scoped amplio context.
items.docs: Wire the plugin: `await app.register(amplioPlugin)` before your routes. `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha doctor` verifies it is imported.

items.name: middleware-trpc
items.title: tRPC Middleware
items.description: tRPC middleware that annotates the ambient request wide event with trpc fields (pair with the Next.js route-handler wrapper).
items.docs: Wire into your procedure bases: `const amplioMiddleware = t.middleware(amplioTrpcMiddleware())` then `.use(amplioMiddleware)` on publicProcedure/protectedProcedure. In a create-t3-app layout, `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha init --wire` edits src/server/api/trpc.ts for you.

items.name: sink-console
items.title: Console Sink
items.description: Console sink that prints wide events as JSON.
items.docs: Wire the sink: add `import { consoleSink } from "./sinks/console"` to telemetry/logger.ts and append `consoleSink` to the init() sinks array. Prefer `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha add sink console` — it wires logger.ts for you.

items.name: sink-json
items.title: JSON Sink
items.description: JSON sink that serializes wide events for streaming or files.
items.docs: Wire the sink: add `import { jsonFileSink } from "./sinks/json"` to telemetry/logger.ts and append `jsonFileSink()` to the init() sinks array; add amplio.jsonl to .gitignore. Prefer `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha add sink json` — it wires all of this for you.

items.name: sink-otlp
items.title: OTLP Sink
items.description: OTLP sink that exports wide events over OpenTelemetry.
items.docs: Wire the sink: add `import { otlpSink } from "./sinks/otlp"` to telemetry/logger.ts and append `otlpSink()` to the init() sinks array; set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINT (full URL, used verbatim) or OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT (base URL, /v1/logs appended). Default is one POST per emit — pass otlpSink({ batch: true }) for production traffic. Prefer `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha add sink otlp` — it wires logger.ts for you.

items.name: enricher-service-metadata
items.title: Service Metadata Enricher
items.description: Enricher that adds service name / environment metadata.
items.docs: Wire the enricher: add `serviceMetadata()` to the init() enrichers array in telemetry/logger.ts. Prefer `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha add enricher service-metadata` — it wires logger.ts for you.

items.name: enricher-query-allowlist
items.title: Query Allowlist Enricher
items.description: Enricher that drops http.search by default (or keeps only allowlisted query params) so query-string PII never reaches sinks.
items.docs: Wire the enricher: add `queryAllowlist()` to the init() enrichers array in telemetry/logger.ts (pass { allow: ["page"] } to keep specific params). Prefer `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha add enricher query-allowlist` — it wires logger.ts for you.

items.name: enricher-request-metadata
items.title: Request Metadata Enricher
items.description: Enricher that adds request id / HTTP metadata.
items.docs: requestMetadata is a per-request enricher factory — use it inside middleware/wrappers (requestLogger.set(enrich({}))), not in the init() enrichers array.

items.name: integration-next-auth
items.title: NextAuth (Auth.js) Integration
items.description: NextAuth v5 events hook that emits amplio auth events (uses local message types — no next-auth type imports needed).
items.docs: Wire into your NextAuth config: `events: amplioNextAuthEvents()` (create-t3-app: src/server/auth/config.ts), and wrap src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts with withAmplio so rows share the request spine's request_id (`amplio init --wire` does this). After a shadcn install, run `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha doctor --fix` to wire event barrels.

items.name: integration-better-auth
items.title: Better Auth Integration
items.description: Better Auth helpers that emit amplio auth events.
items.docs: Wire the plugin: add `createBetterAuthAmplioPlugin()` to your betterAuth({ plugins: [...] }) config. After a shadcn install, run `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha doctor --fix` to wire event barrels.

items.name: integration-clerk
items.title: Clerk Integration
items.description: Clerk helpers that emit amplio auth events.
items.docs: Call handleClerkWebhook from your Clerk webhook route (user.created / session.created). After a shadcn install, run `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha doctor --fix` to wire event barrels.

items.name: integration-resend
items.title: Resend Integration
items.description: Resend email helpers that emit amplio events (uses local webhook types — no resend package needed).
items.docs: Call trackResendEmail after sending, or handleResendWebhook from your Resend webhook route. After a shadcn install, run `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha doctor --fix` to wire event barrels.

items.name: integration-polar
items.title: Polar Integration
items.description: Polar payment helpers that emit amplio order-paid events (uses local webhook types — no @polar-sh/sdk needed).
items.docs: Call handlePolarWebhook (or trackPolarOrderPaid) from your Polar webhook route (order.paid). After a shadcn install, run `npx @useamplio/cli@alpha doctor --fix` to wire event barrels.
